category_title: At-risk dyscalculic pupils with core deficits in representing and processing numerosity
scenario_title: Hesitation and lack of one-to-one correspondence during counting
minimal_context: The student is working one-on-one with a tutor to count the total number of pips on a mathematics domino card.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to look at some mathematics domino cards today. Can you count out loud for me first?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you. Now, look at this domino card. Please count the pips from the left side.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Concentrates on the task and speaks aloud) One, two, three, four, five.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How many pips are there on the domino card?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks around and pauses for a while before starting to count verbally again) One, two, three, four, five... five.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are going to look at some mathematics domino cards today. Can you count out loud for me first?

STUDENT: One, two, three... nine.

TUTOR: Thank you. Now, look at this domino card. Please count the pips from the left side.

STUDENT: (Concentrates on the task and speaks aloud) One, two, three, four, five.

TUTOR: How many pips are there on the domino card?

STUDENT: (Looks around and pauses for a while before starting to count verbally again) One, two, three, four, five... five.

task.content: Counting the total number of pips on a domino card
task.learning_goal: Mediate the meaning of one-to-one correspondence and the order-irrelevant principle

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked 'How many pips are there on the domino card?'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Looked around and paused for a while before starting to count verbally
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Motivated to learn and willing to speak aloud when supported

behavior_patterns.condition: When required to count objects to find a total
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Pauses and looks around before initiating counting
